errors.text_span: Фигурата илюстрира разпределението на стойностите на вратовете (gate values) за различни варианти на изходно вратово управление при SDPA
errors.evidence: The description includes information from the paper's caption ('...за различни варианти на изходно вратово управление при SDPA') that is not present in the figure itself, which is only titled 'atten_output_gate gate values'.

errors.text_span: с етикети на всяко цяло число
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the x-axis has labels at every integer. The figure shows labels only at intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20).

errors.text_span: синя пунктирана линия с кръгли маркери представя средната стойност (mean), оранжева пунктирна линия с кръгли маркери показва стандартното отклонение (std)
errors.evidence: The description hallucinates 'round markers' ('кръгли маркери') for the 'mean' and 'std' lines. The figure shows these lines without any visible markers.
The description refers to the orange 'std' line as a dashed line ('пунктирна линия'), but it is a dotted line.
The description refers to the green 'min' line as a dashed line ('пунктирна линия'), but it is a dash-dot line.
The description claims the 'mean' line peaks around 0.2 at layer 18. In the figure, the value at layer 18 is about 0.1; the actual peaks near 0.2 are at layers 13 and 16.

errors.text_span: и завършва при стойност около 0.17 при слой 22
errors.evidence: The description states that the 'std' line ends at a value of ~0.17 at layer 22. In the figure, the value at layer 22 is ~0.1, and the line continues to layer 23 where it has a value of ~0.14. Both the value and the end point are incorrect.
This phrase is from the paper's caption and is not present in the figure itself, which is titled 'atten_output_gate gate values'.
The legend indicates that the 'min' line style is dash-dotted ('-.'), not dashed ('--').

errors.text_span: a peak of about 0.21 around layer 20
errors.evidence: For the 'std' line, the peak at layer 20 is approximately 0.19, which is visibly below the 0.2 grid line. The stated value of 0.21 is a significant overestimation.
The value of the 'std' line at layer 22 is approximately 0.15, not 0.17.
The legend indicates that the 'mean' line style is dashed ('--'), not dash-dotted ('-.').

errors.text_span: rises to a peak of about 0.21 around layer 18
errors.evidence: The 'mean' line does not peak at layer 18; its value there is approximately 0.1. The highest peak for the 'mean' line is at layer 13, with a value of approximately 0.2.

errors.text_span: Das Diagramm zeigt die Verteilung der Gating-Scores für verschiedene SDPA-Ausgabegating-Varianten unter unterschiedlichen Einschränkungen
errors.evidence: This information is likely from the paper's caption but is not present in the figure itself. The figure's title is "atten_output_gate gate values". The description introduces external context not visually verifiable.
The x-axis data points extend to layer 23, not 22.

errors.text_span: steigt bis zu einem Maximum von etwa 0.21 bei Schicht 18
errors.evidence: The 'mean' line reaches its maximum value of approximately 0.2 at layer 13, not layer 18. At layer 18, the value is much lower, around 0.1.
The 'mean' line ends at layer 23 with a value of approximately 0.03. The value at layer 22 is approximately 0.1, not 0.04.

errors.text_span: steigt bis zu einem Maximum von etwa 0.19 bei Schicht 21
errors.evidence: The 'std' line reaches its highest peak of approximately 0.2 at layer 20, not 0.19 at layer 21. At layer 21, the value has dropped to around 0.13.
The 'std' line ends at layer 23 with a value of approximately 0.19, which is a local peak. It does not end at 0.16.
The line style for 'min' is dash-dot, not dashed ('gestrichelt').
